$description: Defines what valid delegation context looks like for Task tool calls. Used by pre-delegation-validator.js (PreToolUse hook) to catch corruption before it propagates to subagents.

$history.v1: Defined from production failure evidence during v1 observation period. Known failure modes: context.json race condition (fixed), skill cache cross-boundary leak, oversized prompts with embedded reports.

prompt.description: The delegation instructions. Should contain task-specific context only.

recommended3P.description: For standard/complex delegations, prompt should include PRODUCT, PROCESS, PERFORMANCE sections
exemptions: direct file operations with clear paths

description.description: Short summary of what the agent will do (3-5 words recommended)

subagent_type.description: Must match a known agent name from agent-registry.json. If omitted, defaults to general-purpose.

contextPollutionSignals.description: Patterns that suggest the delegation context is contaminated with irrelevant data

signals.reason: Evaluation reports should not be forwarded to new delegations
Prior agent reports should be summarized, not embedded wholesale
Delegation should contain task context, not chat history

notes: This schema is a living document — update it as new failure modes are observed in production.
Pre-delegation-validator.js reads this schema at hook execution time.
Advisory checks surface warnings but do not block delegation.
Error-level checks surface prominent warnings that the conductor should address before proceeding.
